Simulates plasticine using St.Venant-Kirchhoff (StVK) constitutive model combined with von-Mises plastic return mapping.

The stress associated with the model is defined by $\mathbf{T}(\mathbf{F}) = \mathbf{U}(2\mu\mathbf{\epsilon} + \lambda \text{Tr}(\mathbf{\epsilon}))\mathbf{U}^T$, where $\mathbf{F} = \mathbf{U}\mathbf{\Sigma}\mathbf{V}$ is the SVD of deformation gradient $\mathbf{F}$, and $\mathbf{\epsilon} = \log(\mathbf{\Sigma})$ is the Hencky strain.

The von-Mises yielding condition is $\delta\gamma = \|\hat{\mathbf{\epsilon}}\| - \frac{\tau_Y}{2\mu} > 0$, where $\hat{\mathbf{\epsilon}}$ is the normalized Hencky strain. $\tau_Y$ is the yield stress, which is the parameter for this model. $\delta\gamma > 0$ means the deformation gradient is outside the elastic region.
